title: Tanyag Eggplant: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: Tanyag Eggplant: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: Tanyag eggplant is an eggplant variety for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao. 61 to 82 days to harvest, 16.2 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: Tanyag is a registered eggplant variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2013 as NSIC 2013 Eg 04H. It takes 61 to 82 days from transplanting to the first harvest, with 16.19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Tanyag eggplant takes 61 to 82 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 11.3 days faster than the average of the 9 eggplant varieties with a day count, 82.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 16.19 t/ha trails the average of its group, 20.34. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt).

The pests and diseases that hit eggplant fields most often: [eggplant fruit and shoot borer](/pests/eggplant-fruit-and-shoot-borer), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant Tanyag eggplant

It is recommended for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao in both the wet and the dry season. Buyers in each market want their own talong: long and slim and dark purple in most of Luzon, rounder or striped in some towns. Pick a variety with bacterial wilt resistance, and plan for the fruit and shoot borer whatever you plant, because no variety on the market resists it. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 61 to 82 days from transplanting to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 16.19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
It is recommended for Luzon, the Visayas and Mindanao in both the wet and the dry season. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Tanyag?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
